Override with the `baseUrl` config or the `DSH_MEM_BASE_"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"URL` environment variable."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:<37700 + uid % 100>` | Worker base URL. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Per-request timeout (ms). |
| `dedupe` | `true` | Collapse duplicate observations in query results ("},{"id":"p24s3","text":"content fingerprint, never identity). |
| `platformSource` | unset | Optional platform filter; omitt"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ed = search all memory. |
| `project` | unset | Project name; defaults to the session cwd basename. "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"|
| `injectContext` | `true` | Inject session-start context. |
| `ingest` | `false` | Save observed "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"tool results as memories. |
| `summarize` | `false` | Summarize sessions on turn stop. |
| `toolFilt"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"er.names` | `read, write, edit, bash` | Tools observed when `ingest` is true. |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Platform scoping is a **signal, never a restriction**: default requests are unfiltered, and `platfor"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"mSource` only adds an opt-in filter."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Duplicate handling"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The worker can persist the same observation many times (a boilerplate "session
initiated" record, or"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" a re-run tool result) — identical content, different `id`.
With `dedupe: true` (the default), query"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" results collapse those copies: an
observation's **content fingerprint** is built from `title` + `su"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"btitle` +
`text` + `narrative` + `facts` (normalized), so two entries that merely share a
generated "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"title but differ in narrative are kept. The first copy (lowest `id`)
is retained. Structured results"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" (`mem_get_observations`) are deduplicated by
fingerprint; rendered index/text results are deduplica"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ted by exact rendered
row. Set `dedupe: false` to see the raw, unfiltered results."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Example override in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `mem_search` | Search memory; returns an index (ids, titles, types). |
| `mem_timeline` | Get cont"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ext around one observation. |
| `mem_get_observations` | Fetch full details for ids. |
| `mem_save` "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"| Save one manual memory. |
| `mem_context` | Render the worker's session-start context text. |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The `mem-search` skill teaches the model the `search → filter → fetch` workflow that keeps token usa"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"m-search` skill teaches the model the `search → filter → fetch` workflow that keeps token usage low."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The package targets Node ≥ 20.12, TypeScript 6.0, and is authored against the `@deepseek-ai/*` frame"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"work packages (cordis, schemastery, dsh-tools, dsh-llm, dsh-skill, dsh-agent)."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Apache-2.0 © Bleed00"}],"truncated":false}
